results.name: intermediate_scalar_competitor_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing an intermediate-feature-count competitor on informative trials with at least three distinct candidate feature counts; tests over-prediction of intermediate candidates in multi-level scalar hierarchies.

results.name: maximal_referent_duplicate_distractor_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing a 4-feature maximal referent when competing against duplicated 1-feature referents on informative trials; tests under-prediction of maximal referents in duplicate scenes.

results.name: spurious_singleton_cluttered_competitor_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing a visual singleton candidate with redundant features when minimal compatible candidates are duplicated on informative trials; tests over-attraction to cluttered singletons from the singleton prior.

results.name: redundant_singleton_vs_redundant_duplicates_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing a visual singleton candidate when competing against duplicated candidates where all candidates have redundant features (>1 feature) on informative trials; tests under-prediction of singleton salience in redundant scenes.

results.name: scalar_competitor_unique_feature_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing a 2-feature candidate possessing an unmentioned feature unique in the scene when competing against duplicate candidates; tests failure to account for contextual uniqueness of unmentioned features.

results.name: scalar_implicature_maximal_competitor_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing a 4-feature candidate on informative trials where exactly one minimal candidate and one 4-feature candidate are compatible and distractors are absent or duplicated; tests under-prediction of maximal referents in scalar implicature.

results.name: prior_singleton_uniform_distractors_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing the visual singleton on uninformative prior trials in 6-object displays with 5 identical distractors; tests under-prediction of singleton salience in large uniform competitor sets.

results.name: exhaustive_minimal_target_decisiveness
results.description: Rate of choosing a unique 1-feature minimal target when competing against duplicated multi-feature competitors on informative trials; tests under-production of pragmatic contrast when a fully exhaustive description applies.
